tests.case: Explicit light background, actual microscope illustration

covers: light/dark colors and one global square grid

observed_limitations: Native image generation alone approximated the grid, even after one correction per mode.
The SVG finalizer produces exact grid geometry but can simplify thin details; all output still needs visual review.
The SVG is editable as grid marks, not semantic illustration components.
output_method: Native image generation with three shared form studies plus mode application reference; deterministic square-grid SVG finalization; SVG rendered to PNG.
reference_preview_fix: Light application PNG re-rendered from full SVG to avoid OS thumbnail cropping.
